title: Realisation of constraints in underdamped Langevin dynamics
summary: This article deals with the realisation of constraints in underdamped Langevin dynamics via soft-constrained dynamics. Specifically, we study systems with a large (or small) parameter that controls the constraint mechanisms, e.g. the strength of confinement forces, mass or friction coefficients, and we derive quantitative convergence results for both the constrained variables and the softly constrained dynamics on the limiting subspace.
